text:
A little footage from the football game I'm building in C with raylib. Still rough, but seeing the little players chase a ball around a pitch makes all the low-level work feel worth it.

#gamedev #indiedev
alt: Work-in-progress pixel-art football gameplay, with red and blue teams moving toward the penalty area.

text:
So much of a football game happens away from the ball. Positioning, support runs, defenders deciding where to go... I keep watching the whole pitch when testing this little project.

A snapshot of the current build. #gamedev
alt: A goalkeeper stands near the goal while red and blue outfield players approach the penalty area. A minimap appears in the upper left.

text:
The less glamorous side of my football game: a VCR-style debug tool. I can scrub back through recorded game states and inspect what happened.

Tiny players, surprisingly useful debugging tools. #gamedev #raylib
alt: The football game is paused with a VCR debug panel. Dragging its timeline moves backward and forward through recorded gameplay.
